title: Craftable Experience Bottles
description: This datapack allows players to craft experience bottles
body:
# Craftable Experience Bottles

Tired of spending hours to grind for experience bottles?

Craftable Experience Bottles adds a simple and balanced way to craft experience bottles. Perfect for survival worlds, Minecraft Smps and even UHC events.

**✨ Features:**
- Allows experience bottles to be easily crafted using only 1 glass bottle and 4 lapis lazuli in a crafting table
- Lightweight and easy to use
- Works well for vanilla-friendly gameplay

**📦 Why use this datapack?**

Normally, experience bottles are hard to get consistently in survival. This datapack gives players a fair and convenient way to access them without commands or creative mode.
